title: GIANT use cases
dataPoints:
Method,Description
Gene-first,"they use various methods to get a list of prioritized genes. They’re interested in noncoding variants connected to those genes by ABC, or colocalized variants there"
Variant-first,"coloc variants within genes coming from TWAS. Do these variants overlap specific annotations within the coloc tissue? We might want the LDSC enrichment for these. If there’s a variant with a particular PIP score, what’s the best way of understanding which tissue annotations it overlaps with best? CS2CT would be the best method for this.  Problem: if we have a high PIP variant, how do we know which tissue to select without selecting it first? Solution: don’t make the tissue filter mandatory within the CS2CT tissue search page"
Variants in credible set,"can we add a search parameter to search by gene first instead of by region? Switch to something more like the variant sifter interface. We want SNP to gene annotations. Need to start by querying some genes were interested in, eg IRX6, then go to the gene and find which variants have SNP to gene connection. Doing this requires the annotations to be visible earlier in the process. We’ve been holding off on this until the data stuff gets resolved, but data is now set, so Patrick will rebuild the bioindex and then we can build the UI."
Credible set-based approach,"We want LDSC displayed-Patrick has generated the data, but we still need to work on figuring out to display it"
Variant and credible set, ask if they overlap with a credible set
